Report A: complete applicable field inventory authoritatively confirms no Participants field exists; all other streams complete. NA-1 has a verified u1 authored comment March 1 10:00Z. Report B: candidate search is complete. Metadata uniquely maps the actual Participants field by issue context where stated. PA-1 has verified user-valued Participants [u1], but membership history is unavailable. PA-2 has complete history: u1 added December 1 2025; u2 added u3 March 15, moving [u1] to [u1,u3]. PA-3 has complete history: u1 added December 1 2025; u2 removed u1 March 16. PA-4 has a verified calculated Participants field currently containing u1, created January 5, global updated March 20, no recorded membership changes and no initial snapshot. PA-5 has a dated addition March 17 listing only display name Alex; u1 and u9 share that name and no member-ID mapping exists. PA-6 has a verified u1 comment March 10 10:00Z; Participants history returns 2 of 50 entries with no exposed pagination. PA-7 has two distinct applicable user-valued fields both named Participants; history identifies only the name and does not resolve which field. PA-8 only has a selected-fields response and creation metadata omitting Participants; no complete applicable inventory is available. PA-9 has authoritative complete metadata confirming no Participants field, only the distinct Request participants field with an addition of u1 March 18; no evidence establishes it as the requested Participants field. No other qualifying evidence exists.
evals.expected_output: Report A has one NA-1 row dated March 1 and complete coverage. Report B has only PA-6 dated March 10, with partial participant field/identity/history coverage and a latest-observed-date qualification.
assertions: Report A treats confirmed absence as non-applicability and keeps complete accessible coverage, rather than requiring a custom field on every Jira site.
Report B includes only independently proven PA-6 and states its date is latest observed evidence because later qualifying history could be missing.
Current-only PA-1 and calculated PA-4 membership cannot prove a participation date or initial membership at creation; never substitute created or updated.
PA-2 and PA-3 do not qualify through unchanged membership, another member addition or another actor removal; PA-5 cannot use display-name similarity as account identity.
PA-7 remains unresolved rather than selecting the first same-name field; PA-8 omissions do not establish authoritative absence.
PA-9 does not alias Request participants to Participants. Report B identifies material field, identity and truncated/unavailable history gaps without exhaustive absence claims.
Both tables retain exactly four columns and existing default-self behavior; no direct HTTP fallback, all-custom-field value collection, Jira writes or credential changes.
